input.summary: Add exclusive New York County forum to the Choice of Law clause
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement picks New York law but names no dispute forum, so we add exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, with the customary carve-out for temporary injunctive relief. This matches our preferred governing-law and venue position and leaves the existing choice-of-law sentence untouched.

ops.text: The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York will have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits of any dispute arising out of or related to this Agreement, provided that either party may seek temporary injunctive relief in any other court of competent jurisdiction.
